name: Chestnut green rice
summary: Cốm hạt dẻ is young Pì Pất glutinous rice, boiled, dried, and pounded, then rubbed with pounded chestnut. Eat it by the handful in autumn. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Trung Khanh, on the eastern road.
howToEat: Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023: cut the rice while it is still milky, boil it, dry it, and pound it until the grain is translucent green. Boil or roast the chestnut, peel it, pound it, and rub it through the rice. The green grain sits on the yellow nut. The taste is the nuttiness of both.
A price is Check on arrival.
where: Trung Khanh, in autumn, when the rice is still milky and the chestnut is in.
